rows.title: Gut, Oral, and Fungal Microbiota in Hypertension: A Multi-Compartment Systematic Review.
rows.evidence_boundary: The synthesis is dominated by observational microbiome studies; compartment, sequencing, population, and confounding differences prevent causal or intervention-level conclusions.

rows.title: A randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled crossover trial on cannabinoid-based medication for behavioural disorders in old patients with severe dementia: the study results.
rows.evidence_boundary: This small crossover trial used a specific oral THC:CBD formulation in very old patients with severe dementia; findings are formulation-, dose-, and disease-specific and require replication.

rows.title: Balancing efficacy and risk: A toxicological review and safety transformation of Berberis plants and their alkaloids.
rows.evidence_boundary: Safety signals vary across Berberis species, isolated alkaloids, doses, routes, and vulnerable populations; the review does not establish a single class-wide safe exposure.

rows.title: The effects of coenzyme Q10 supplementation on exercise-induced oxidative stress and related physiological outcomes in athletes: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
rows.evidence_boundary: Athlete trials differ in training status, CoQ10 form, dose, duration, and oxidative-stress endpoints; pooled effects should not be generalized to performance benefit or a specific product.

rows.title: Serum magnesium and major adverse cardiovascular events in patients with diabetic foot ulcers: a retrospective cohort study.
rows.evidence_boundary: Baseline serum magnesium is evaluated as an observational prognostic marker in diabetic foot ulcer patients; the study explicitly does not establish a causal or therapeutic effect of magnesium supplementation.
